title: hbench dataset index, v1
description: The one layer (media type application/vnd.hbench.dataset-index.v1+json) of a registry's dataset index: an OCI image manifest with artifactType application/vnd.hbench.dataset-index.v1, tagged latest in <namespace>/index. It lists the dataset versions under <namespace>, so that `hbench datasets list --registry oci://<registry>/<namespace>` can name them; hbench opens each one by its digest and checks its name and version. Entries may also carry what a catalog shows (domain, description, n_tasks, license), so a list needs no dataset opened. hbench 0.5 refuses any field but name, version and digest, so an index with them breaks 0.5's listing; later versions ignore fields they don't know.

datasets.description: Every listed dataset version, at most once each.

version.description: The tag of the dataset version in its repository.

digest.description: The digest of the dataset's manifest, which the tag names.

domain.description: Optional. The listing's domain (e.g. "Employment law"): the catalog files the dataset under the app domain it maps to when its name doesn't place it.

description.description: Optional. A sentence or two on what the tasks ask, shown in the catalog before the dataset is opened.

n_tasks.description: Optional. How many tasks the version holds (the manifest's layers).

license.description: Optional. The licence: an SPDX expression or a name.
